\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}

Imaginary oracles answer every query~\cite{FakeA20,FakeB21}. We show in \cref{thm:main} that an adversary $\Adv$ wins $\G{0}$ with probability $\Pro{\rho}{\text{bad at $t$}}\le\qq/N$.
The proof uses Section~\ref{sec:games} and \Cref{lem:one,lem:two}.

\paragraph{Contributions}
We list them:
\begin{itemize}
  \item a bound, see \eqref{eq:bound};
  \item a game hop:
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item swap the points,
    \item count them;
  \end{enumerate}
  \item and a formal proof.\footnote{The proof is imaginary; see \url{https://example.org/x_y}.}
\end{itemize}
